readout_other: multi-unit and single-unit spiking with ultraflexible nanoelectric thread electrodes; RSU/FSU classification
direction_notes: Time-locked and delayed spiking of regular spiking units increased nonlinearly with pressure; FSUs showed delayed responses; effective PRF and duty cycle ranges shifted at 1300 kPa compared with 100 kPa.
safety_notes: Brain temperature measured with a fibre-optic probe in four separate rats: rises up to 2.1 C with pressure and up to 0.53 C with duty cycle; mechanical index tabulated in the supplement.

exposures.label: Rat S1, 1.5 MHz, pressure, duty-cycle and PRF sweeps

device.model: customized H276 128-element random array (driven by Verasonics Vantage 128)

timing.protocol_description: 505 trials per series with a 67 ms sonication every 2 s (10% trigger jitter). Pressure sweep at 1500 Hz PRF/30% DC and 30 Hz PRF/0.6% DC; duty cycle swept 0.6-60% at 1500 Hz PRF; PRF swept 30-4500 Hz at 30% DC, the last two each at 100 and 1300 kPa. Sham was ultrasound delivered off-target to the front of the skull.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Ten adult male Wistar rats weighing \~300 g were used in this study, following a protocol approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC) of Carnegie Mellon University.

source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: This resulted in DCs of 0.6%, 6%, 30%, and 60%.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Schematic of the ultrasound stimulation paradigms used in this study. a Parameter sets for varying acoustic pressure (100–1300 kPa) at two PRF/DC combinations: 1500 Hz with 30% DC, and 30 Hz with 0.6% DC. All trials use a 1500 kHz fundamental frequency and a 67 ms sonication duration, with stimuli delivered every 2 seconds. b Parameter sets for varying duty cycle (DC) with PRF held constant, tested at both 100 kPa and 1300 kPa. c Parameter sets for varying PRF with DC held constant at 30%, also tested at 100 kPa and 1300 kPa
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: Different pressure levels were delivered by altering the input voltage, resulting in a predicted delivered ultrasound peak-to-peak pressure of 100, 400, 700, 1000, and 1300 kPa.

flags.reason: Pressures are described as predicted delivered peak-to-peak pressure and as estimated through the silicone-covered skull; domain not clearly free-field or in situ, so placed in unspecified_domain. Peak-to-peak, not peak negative. Intensities appear only in the supplementary table.

List assembled from tone-burst durations in several sentences (200 and 300 us in the pressure sweep, 4/40/200/400 us in the duty-cycle sweep, 10000/1000/200/100/67.7 us in the PRF sweep), converted to ms; the quote covers only the PRF-sweep durations.
67 ms total ultrasound duration per trial, one trial every 2 s with 10% jitter; converted to 0.067 s.
Ten rats for electrophysiology (n = 10 per condition stated as a limitation); a separate cohort of four rats was used for temperature measurements and is not counted.
The pressure sweep used 30% DC at 1500 Hz and 0.6% DC at 30 Hz; those values are within the listed duty cycles.

provenance.notes: Order of the five recordings within a series was random (same day); sham was off-target frontal skull stimulation.
